title: CCTV Fall Detection Dataset (synthetic sample)
description:
Synthetic CCTV images of people who have fallen (on their back, side or front) in warehouses, workshops, lobbies, shops, car parks and outdoor sites, by day and at night, plus hard-negative images of people sitting, crouching, squatting or kneeling. 60 images with 92 bounding boxes for the classes person and fallen_person, in YOLO and COCO format.

The images are fully synthetic: no real people and no real incident footage. Each image was generated to a scene and camera specification (environment, camera height and angle, lighting, distance), labelled automatically, checked by a vision-language model for object presence, CCTV realism and box placement, and visually reviewed. The sample is intended for research on detector training, evaluation and false-alarm behaviour under realistic surveillance viewpoints.
